newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nedlloyd, P&O agree credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Nedlloyd, P&O agree credit facility.

text.p: Dutch shipping and road transport group Koninklijke Nedlloyd Groep NV and P&O Containers Limited said on Monday they had signed an agreement for a $1 billion credit facility to finance their merged container businesses.

"This facility will provide finance for P&O Nedlloyd Container Line Limited which will be formed from the merger of the container businesses of Royal Nedlloyd NV and The Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Company," the firms said in a joint statement.
The companies agreed in September to merge their container businesses.
The statement said the facility would be used to fund P&O Nedlloyd's initial borrowing and the company's working capital requirements.

"It will also provide finance for the four 6,600 teu (20-foot equivalent units, a standard measure of volume in container shipping) newbuild vessels the company has on order for delivery in 1998," the statement added.
It said the facility, arranged by ABN Amro Bank and Midland Bank, had a maturity of 10 years and was in the process of being syndicated in the bank market.
